what: List rows, buttons and cards that reach the bottom edge of the screen expand from 50% to 100% width in 1s circ.out as they appear. The inner underline (line) draws from 0 to full length, and the arrow enters from outside the left edge by twice its own width, so award, press, FAQ and blog tables seem to grow from left to right.

options.from: Initial width (%), default 50 — 20 for the service row
options.fade: If off, opacity is left as is, if linear, only opacity runs without a curve (service row)
options.min: Does not move below this width (px), default 768 (original turns off on phones)
options.[data-fx-part=line] · [data-fx-part=arro: (if present) underline drawn from 0, arrow entering from off the left
